pages.text: The Light Devourer is made up of a case holding a dark mass at its center that swirls and consumes the points of lights floating around it, representing a contained miniature black hole. As a tool, it allows the user to semi-permanently absorb the light in a localized empty area. This effect can be nullified by using the tool to 'break' the darkness.

'In darkness, there's a beauty that cannot be sought anywhere else. It is the purest form the fear of the unknown can take. A power so great, its potential is nearly infinite...'            -extract from the Story of Shadows
